We propose a four-week engagement in our usual four movements. We listen to the people who use each system and write down what they actually do. We trace every record type back to its source of truth. We tune a single working prototype that reads from all three and shows the conflicts side by side. Then we hand it over and make sure it echoes in your own workflow, with documentation your staff can maintain.
